pages.text: Eight bugs can be tamed, in four pairs. Each pair shares a $(thing)treat$().$(br2)Feed a wild one its treat: each treat has a 1 in 3 chance to tame it (hearts) or not (smoke). Tamed bugs never attack you or other tamed bugs, and they never despawn.
pages.title: Taming

pages.text: Feed two tamed adults of the same kind and they'll find each other and have a tamed baby. Babies are half size and grow up in one day (treats speed that up). Parents rest for 5 minutes before breeding again.
pages.title: Breeding
